content.summary: The completed support-53 interface matches the advertised family hypotheses and actual-support conclusion. The finite equivalence is correctly distinguished from excluding its obstruction. Canonical snapshot, manuscript, and inspected source hashes match. No framing revision is required in this fresh run.

checks.method: Compared the frozen manuscript with SupportFinish53 and the expanded literal_support53 statement; checked source digests against F01 and receipts F11/F13.
checks.observation: The root quantifies over Type u, requires exactly 28 distinct four-sets, reflexive intersection, and exclusion of a three-member subfamily with common pairwise core. Empty cores are permitted. Its conclusion bounds the union itself by 53, without a quotient, I(27), or finite ambient-type premise. Receipts report exit zero and the three permitted foundational axioms.

checks.scope: Fin 53 equivalence and strength of conclusions
checks.method: Read both directions in SupportReduction and the expanded literal_i27_iff_no_fin53 interface.
checks.observation: The forward direction applies I(27) to a finite obstruction; the converse restricts a counterexample to 28 members and relabels its bounded support injectively. The named I(27) interface quantifies over Type, while the counterexample reduction is universe-polymorphic. Neither direction supplies obstruction nonexistence, consistent with the manuscript’s explicit exclusion limitation. Detailed arithmetic and dependency assurance remain later-round checks.
